ih_display_code_claims_zone_sequence_uni.name: ih_display_code_claims_zone_sequence_unique
ih_display_code_claims_zone_sequence_uni.where: "ih_display_code_claims"."rule_version" = 2 AND "ih_display_code_claims"."zone_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_display_code_claims"."sequence" IS NOT NULL

ih_electrical_assets_source_check.name: ih_electrical_assets_source_check
ih_electrical_assets_source_check.value:
("ih_electrical_assets"."source_kind" = 'GRID' AND "ih_electrical_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_id" IS NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_tbc" = false)
    OR ("ih_electrical_assets"."source_kind" = 'BOARD' AND "ih_electrical_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_tbc" = false)
    OR ("ih_electrical_assets"."source_kind" = 'TBC' AND "ih_electrical_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_id" IS NULL AND "ih_electrical_assets"."electrical_parent_tbc" = true)
    OR ("ih_electrical_assets"."source_kind" = 'LEGACY' AND "ih_electrical_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL)

ih_measurement_assignments_target_check.name: ih_measurement_assignments_target_check
ih_measurement_assignments_target_check.value:
("ih_measurement_assignments"."target_kind" = 'BOARD' AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_board_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_site_asset_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."status" = 'CONFIRMED')
    OR ("ih_measurement_assignments"."target_kind" = 'SITE_ASSET' AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_board_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_site_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."status" = 'CONFIRMED')
    OR ("ih_measurement_assignments"."target_kind" = 'GRID_BOUNDARY' AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_board_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_site_asset_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_grid_supply_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."status" = 'CONFIRMED')
    OR ("ih_measurement_assignments"."target_kind" = 'TBC' AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_board_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_site_asset_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."target_grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_measurement_assignments"."status" = 'TBC')

ih_meter_history_events_shape_check.name: ih_meter_history_events_shape_check
ih_meter_history_events_shape_check.value:
(
      "ih_meter_history_events"."operation" = 'REPLACEMENT'
      AND "ih_meter_history_events"."source_form_submission_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "ih_meter_history_events"."restored_from_record_version_number" IS NULL
      AND "ih_meter_history_events"."reason" IS NULL
    ) OR (
      "ih_meter_history_events"."operation" = 'ROLLBACK'
      AND "ih_meter_history_events"."source_form_submission_id" IS NULL
      AND "ih_meter_history_events"."restored_from_record_version_number" IS NOT NULL
      AND length(btrim("ih_meter_history_events"."reason")) >= 3
    )

ih_site_assets_source_check.name: ih_site_assets_source_check
ih_site_assets_source_check.value:
("ih_site_assets"."source_kind" = 'GRID' AND "ih_site_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_id" IS NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_tbc" = false)
    OR ("ih_site_assets"."source_kind" = 'BOARD' AND "ih_site_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_tbc" = false)
    OR ("ih_site_assets"."source_kind" = 'TBC' AND "ih_site_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_id" IS NULL AND "ih_site_assets"."electrical_board_tbc" = true)
    OR ("ih_site_assets"."source_kind" = 'LEGACY' AND "ih_site_assets"."grid_supply_id" IS NULL)
